description: This file implements a multi-process fuzzing framework for executing a separate 'fuzzer.py' script with different seeds, managing progress display, handling output, and summarizing results. It includes classes, functions for running fuzzers, handling results, and continuous fuzzing until failure.

classes.name: FuzzerResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of a fuzzing run, including seed, success status, output, duration, ignored pattern index, and operation statistics.

methods.name: persist_print
methods.description: Prints messages, using tqdm if available, or falls back to standard error output. Handles BrokenPipeError by logging to a file.

methods.name: is_ignored_output
methods.description: Checks if the output matches any ignore pattern and returns the index of the pattern or -1 if none match.

methods.name: run_fuzzer_with_seed
methods.description: Runs 'fuzzer.py' with a specific seed and optional supported operations, captures output, parses operation stats, and determines if output should be ignored.

methods.name: print_output_lines
methods.description: Prints non-empty lines of output using a provided write function.

methods.name: handle_result_output
methods.description: Handles formatted output for fuzzing results, including success, failure, and ignored statuses.

methods.name: run_multi_process_fuzzer
methods.description: Runs the fuzzing process across multiple processes, managing progress, collecting results, and printing summaries. Supports verbose output and supports for progress bars.

methods.name: _print_operation_distribution
methods.description: Aggregates and displays operation execution counts from successful fuzzing results.

methods.name: run_until_failure
methods.description: Continuously runs the fuzzer with random starting seeds until a failure is encountered, then outputs a detailed summary and exits.
